findings.message: standard trio: no @claude mention handler — nothing with archetype 'mention-handler'

findings.message: standard trio: no markdown-oneline prose kit — nothing with archetype 'prose-kit'

findings.message: scheduled AI line with no vars.*_ENABLED kill switch — cannot be disarmed without a redeploy (crons: 42 14 * * 6)
findings.fix: Gate the job with if: vars.<LINE>_ENABLED == 'true' (a default-OFF repo variable) so the schedule can be disarmed from repo settings.
